name: Sunbury Ferry
summary: This community passenger ferry links Lower Sunbury with the Walton side of the Thames, just downstream of Sunbury Lock. It is a charming experience in its own right and a useful way to create a circular walk. Bicycles, dogs and pushchairs can be carried when conditions allow.
reasonToVisit: A small passenger ferry crossing that turns a riverside walk into a circular route
planningDetail: Weekends and Bank Holidays in season. Weather and river dependent, check before setting out
